label: Opening Hook
text: In the 1960s, the CIA reportedly tried to turn a cat into a walking microphone.
title: File:Original Headquarters Building (OHB) - Flickr - The Central Intelligence Agency.jpg

label: Terrain & Scale
text: A 1960s project of the CIA's Directorate of Science and Technology A microphone and transmitter were reportedly implanted in a cat A heavily redacted CIA memo released in 2001 concluded the approach was not practical Former CIA official Victor Marchetti claimed it cost about $20 million and that the cat was hit by a taxi; this account is disputed The project was reportedly cancelled around 1967
